title: Canon RF-S 14-30mm F4-6.3 IS STM PZ Lens (New, White Box)

comparisons.notes: Same lens (RF-S14-30mm F4-6.3 IS STM PZ), new, in stock at Canon's own store at a $349.99 sale price (regular $369.99)

writeup: Canon's power-zoom RF-S 14-30mm F4-6.3 IS STM PZ, the ultra-wide companion to the EOS R50 V, is $147.53 on Woot as a new white-box unit (sold as open box). Canon's own store has it at $349.99, so this is about 57% less. It has built-in optical stabilization and fits any RF-mount body. Woot shows only one left.
